summary: All 24 backend pytest cases pass (100%). Verified Auth, KB CRUD, KB search across all 4 modes (vector/hybrid/bm25/ensemble), end-to-end web crawl on https://example.com (status reached `completed`, content searchable via hybrid search, also surfaced via legacy /api/v2/documents as file_type=web), crawl history, MCP listing of 5 built-ins, MCP built-in execution (web-search & http-request returning ok=true with HTTP 200), MCP custom tool create+delete, API Key issuance + X-API-Key auth + post-revoke rejection, Model analytics 4 admin endpoints, and RBAC alias (ROLE_ADMIN == 'admin' allowed on schedules/all). Qdrant embedded mode at /app/backend/qdrant_data is operational — crawl preflight returned 200 (would have returned 503 only if unreachable). Legacy regression smoke-checked: /api/v2/documents and /api/v2/sessions respond 200 with expected data.
critical_code_review_comments: knowledge_base.py crawl preflight returns 503 with a message recommending docker-compose, but in embedded mode users would still get a generic 503 if the embedded path was wrong — consider differentiating 'embedded init failed' vs 'server unreachable' messaging.
api_keys.py revoke endpoint returns 200 but list endpoint still returns the revoked row with revoked=true; consider hiding revoked keys behind a query flag for cleaner UI.
knowledge_base.py update_kb silently no-ops when no fields are provided (returns the existing doc) — fine, but consider 400 to make API contracts clearer.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral KBs created and cleaned up by session-scope fixtures: TEST_KB_doc, TEST_KB_web. One ephemeral MCP tool TEST_custom_http (deleted). One ephemeral API key TEST_key (revoked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_ai.py is the regression suite. It depends on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Crawler test hits https://example.com — if outbound blocked, that test will fail. Qdrant embedded path: /app/backend/qdrant_data. Built-in MCP tools are seeded on backend startup (see server.py L115-153).
